title: Tenure Charging of the Site Transfer Fee: Small Business Electricity Supply Terms and Conditions
content:
**Tenure charging.** On the site transfer fee of a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement, the whole months from the agreement's service start date to the handling date are counted; an agreement supplied 36 months or more is charged one half (0.5) of the reduced fee; an agreement supplied 12 to 35 months is charged the reduced fee prorated to the share of its term still to run, that is the reduced fee multiplied by the whole months left to its contract end date and divided by its term's months; an agreement supplied fewer than 12 months is charged the reduced fee as it stands.

The reduced fee is the site transfer fee after the amounts taken off it, never below zero. Whole months run by calendar month, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached; the whole months left run from the handling date to the contract end date on the agreement record, and the term's months are the term length on that record.

| Whole months supplied | Fee charged |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | one half of the reduced fee |
| 12 to 35 | the reduced fee multiplied by the whole months left and divided by the term's months |
| fewer than 12 | the reduced fee as it stands |

**Hypothetical agreements, each with a reduced fee of 26.00 USD**

| Whole months supplied | Term | Whole months left | Fee charged (before rounding) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 40 | 36 months | any | 13.00 USD |
| 30 | 36 months | 14 | 26.00 multiplied by 14 and divided by 36, that is 10.1111 USD |
| 8 | 24 months | 15 | 26.00 USD |

Boundaries: 11 whole months supplied, as it stands; 12, prorated; 35, prorated; 36, one half.
